# INV-USD-001 linked to a parked split carrying more than the invoice owes,
# with the residue declared.
#
# `prepayment: 20.00` is what the run itself asked for, and supplying it is
# what a reader would do next — which is why the file has to be refused rather
# than accepted: the figure is right about the money and wrong about what the
# carve would produce, because the carve reads the parked split's 166.80 CAD
# instead.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the two figures and the account
# the split sits on.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-02
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "0718293a4b5c6d7e8f90011223344556"
    prepayment: 20.00
